confidence_explanation: The timeline shows a clear progression from automated SQL injection attempts to a successful account takeover, privilege escalation, massive database querying, and large-scale data exfiltration, followed by an attempt to cover tracks by deleting logs.

attack_chain.description: Automated SQL injection attempts using sqlmap from IP 104.244.76.13.
Successful login of user_03 from the same suspicious IP (104.244.76.13) during off-hours.
Privilege escalation where user_03 was elevated to 'dba' status.
Unauthorized bulk querying of the 'customers' table, affecting hundreds of thousands of rows.
Data exfiltration via DNS tunneling (UDP/53) to a known malicious domain.
Massive data exfiltration via HTTPS (TCP/443) totaling approximately 300MB.
Anti-forensic activity: deletion of the authentication log (/var/log/auth.log) to hide the intrusion.

gaps: Confirmation of whether user_03's credentials were stolen via the SQL injection or if the SQL injection was a separate attempt.
Verification of the destination of the HTTPS traffic (evt_s95_042-053).
narrative: An attacker used SQL injection attempts to facilitate the compromise of user_03's account. Once logged in from a suspicious IP, the attacker escalated privileges to DBA, queried a massive amount of customer data, and exfiltrated over 300MB of data via DNS and HTTPS before deleting authentication logs to hide their presence.
